text:
support-ops: heads-up :rotating_light: getting a bunch of 503s from hosted inference in us-west1 since ~09:12 UTC. multiple customers. gateway shows upstream 500/503s

sara-sre: seeing it too. infer-worker pool `infer-usw1-prod-*` has restart ramp, kube shows OOMKilled then SIGSEGV on some pods

mike-ml: quick glance at logs — segfaults tied to large KV prefetch during long-context requests, looks memory-related

sara-sre: paste of last lines from one pod:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] infer-runner[1423]: GPU_MEM_ALLOC failed: out of memory (requested 1234567890 bytes)
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] infer-runner[1423]: terminating with signal 11 (SIGSEGV)
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] container runtime: killing container, exit code 139
kubectl describe pod infer-usw1-prod-abcde -n hosted -> Last State: Terminated, Reason: OOMKilled / Exit: 139
```

support-ops: customer traces show requests with ~30k tokens + toolcall. we pushed a couple of small rollouts yesterday — could be interaction with quantized runtime swap?

mike-ml: possible. repro steps I used locally to trigger tail of memory growth:
1) POST /v1/generate with prompt ~28k tokens + system messages
2) set `max_new_tokens=1024` and `batch_size=4`
3) observe kvcache prefetch and memory climb -> segfault within 90s

commands we ran: `kubectl logs -n hosted infer-usw1-prod-abcde -c infer --tail=200` and `gdb --batch --ex "bt full" -c /var/crash/cores/infer-1423.core`

alex-eng: rolled back quant-runtime 0.9.2 -> 0.9.1 on two nodes, that dropped 503s immediately for a few customers :thumbsup:

sara-sre: collecting core dumps and perf maps, attached core `/var/crash/cores/infer-1423.core` to ticket IN-2026-0453. adding reproducer and heap profile

jess-pm: thanks — please start customer notification for impacted orgs (outline in support playbook). pause any non-critical rollouts to that pool until root cause known

oncall-bot: Incident created: IN-2026-0453 | Severity: P1 | Owners: eng-runtime, eng-ml

support-ops: assigning to @sara-sre and @mike-ml for triage. next steps: collect full heap/profile, reproduce on staging with quant-runtime 0.9.2, add temporary routing fallback to smaller-model variant for affected customers

mike-ml: I'll try to repro on a staged 8xA100 with long-context run + quant swap. if it's KV prefetch growth we can add a cap or backpressure quickly

sara-sre: temp mitigation deployed: autoscaler set to prefer non-quant nodes, fallback routing to model-v1-small for heavy-context requests, and kswap tuned. monitoring dashboards updated

support-ops: will follow up with CS/Sales for any billing-impact questions. logging ticket + notes in ops-runbook.

jess-pm: keep updates short here; we need ETA for full fix and postmortem plan. also capture customer-facing timeline

sara-sre: ETA investig 3-4h, hotfix (if repro) by EOD otherwise rollback plan overnight

mike-ml: posting traceback and heap diff link to IN-2026-0453 in a few mins

support-ops: thanks all, continuing triage. ping me if you need customer contact details or to escalate to Eng leadership
